name: Vita Sauna
description:
A diminutive sauna room loaded with luxury—perfect for master bathrooms or smaller spaces that limit the sauna size—but without limiting the features.

Outside dimensions: Depth 63”, Width 63”, Height 84”
Contemporary glass-to-glass corner creates an amazingly open feel
Luxury backrests with integral LED lighting
Mini Gimbal spot light over the heater
Color therapy/white lighting in ceiling, optional
Interior and exterior of clear, vertical grain Canadian Hemlock (Western Red Cedar optional)
Benches and backrests two-tone combination of Canadian Hemlock and heat-treated European Alder
Lower platform bench wraps around heater
Sauna Heater: Piccolo rock-tower heater, 3.5 kW with Pure 2.0 digital control
